thread:
Nadia Flores: hey team, first rotation this week — two quick setup snags: 1) my PagerDuty test says delivered but no Slack thread created, and 2) I get a 403 when trying to fetch runbooks. who should I ping? :wave:
Eli Turner: welcome Nadia! Slack bridge only opens threads when alerts include a mapped `service` tag. If you used the generic test it might not map. Try: `redwoodctl alert send --service=infra-shadow --desc "nadia test"`. Also for runbooks, 403 usually means missing git team membership or stale Okta session.
Nadia Flores: ran the command you suggested and the Slack thread appeared, nice. For the repo error I used HTTPS and got `fatal: unable to access 'https://git.redwood.com/runbooks/': 403`
Camille Zhou: added you to git-runbooks and forced an Okta sync. If you need immediate read access you can `gh auth login` and use ssh as a fallback.
Oncall Bot: PagerDuty->Slack bridge updated for `infra-shadow`. Reminder: complete the "Shadow Orientation" checklist in Confluence before first live pages.
Nadia Flores: clone works now, thanks. one more: the shadow session in my calendar says "self-study" — is that normal or should it be with a buddy?
Eli Turner: that calendar event is the pre-shift prep block. Live shadow pairing is a separate invite — check the "shadow pairing" invite later today. For first two live shifts you'll be paired with a senior.
Camille Zhou: short first-response checklist we expect: 1) acknowledge in PD, 2) run `runbook lookup <service>` and paste a 1-line status into #incidents, 3) if nothing resolved in 12m escalate to L2 using `esc escalate --svc <svc> --to L2`, 4) for SEV1 call the incident commander after paging. We'll send you the quick cheatsheet PDF.
Nadia Flores: super clear — appreciate the help. One last Q: who can merge small docs PRs to fix typos in runbooks?
Eli Turner: anyone can open a `docs: runbook` PR; merges require an L2 signer. If it's blocking a recovery during a page, paste the fix in the incident thread and ping @sre-leads for a hotfix merge with the `hotfix` label.
Oncall Bot: Tip: enable mobile critical alerts and add a backup phone number in PagerDuty under Profile -> Contact Methods to avoid silent deliveries.
